| description = If you are working on Halas faction know that Einhorst and Frostbite both give 1pt of faction per kill. Originally Einhorst was listed as 10 points per kill. After following the Halas faction guide, I logged over 20+ hours killing Frostbite to get to Apprehensive with White Rose in Halas. Afterwards I logged 101, 166, 205 Einhorst kills. If Apprehensive requires 400pts of faction to progress... At 205 kills on Einhorst(and still conning Apprehesive to White Rose) Einhorst cannot be 10pts, 5pts, 3pts, or 2pts. He is exactly 1pt per kill. I am 40+ hours working at Halas faction now. I hope this helps the next ambitious player working towards this goal. Apollyus, 50 Ogre Shaman, <Kingdom>, Green server.

WARNING: As a quest NPC, anything given to him while charmed is permanently lost upon his death.
